# Freedoliapp

> The control tower for Amazon FBA operations. Centralises suppliers, purchase orders, samples, inventory, decisions and profit in a single workspace so Amazon sellers can run their business from one place instead of ten spreadsheets.

Freedoliapp is a SaaS product for Amazon FBA sellers and small operators. It replaces a stack of disconnected tools (Sellerboard, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Keepa, Holded) with a single workspace covering the full operational pipeline: research → viability → suppliers → samples → production → listing → live.

The platform is multi-tenant (workspace-isolated via Postgres RLS) and supports Catalan, Spanish and English. Hosted on Vercel, data on Supabase.

## Product

- [Landing page](https://freedoliapp.com): product overview and pricing
- [Pricing](https://freedoliapp.com#pricing): Starter €29, Growth €79, Scale €199 (monthly; ~17% discount yearly)
- [Free trial](https://freedoliapp.com/trial): 14-day trial, no credit card required

## Capabilities

- Project pipeline with 7 phases (Research, Viability, Suppliers, Samples, Production, Listing, Live)
- Supplier management + quote comparison + sample tracking
- Purchase Orders with logistics flow (production → pickup → forwarder → shipping → customs → Amazon FBA)
- Inventory ledger + Weighted Average Cost (WAC)
- Decision Inbox with AI-suggested actions, feedback loop and analytics
- Recurring expenses + invoices + financial ledger
- Amazon SP-API integration + Settlement CSV import
- Profitability calculator (FBA fees, freight, duties, COGS, ads)
- Manufacturer pack PDFs (PO, FNSKU labels, packing list, carton labels)
